items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: My first wife was Dorothy Williams of the Williams' Sisters.

ctx.x: Now you mentioned children. And I do know that you've been married twice. And we need some vital statistics here. Now your first wife was....

My first wife was Dorothy Williams of the Williams' Sisters. They were singers and dancers. And they were very good the Williams' Sisters. They recorded and it was swinging, they were swinging. And her name was Dorothy Williams and we had a baby called Dorothy our daughter. And that was while I was in the show Buddy Rose's 'Crazy Quilt'. Dorothy and I were married, we had a baby and Hannah, her sister, went into Buddy Rose's 'Crazy Quilt' with Fanny Brice, Bill Baker, Ted Healy, James Barton, Georgie Jessel. And…

And we went along like that for about a year I guess and then the show went on the road. And Hannah, no before the show went on the road, Hannah Williams married Roger Wolfe Kahn the international banker's son. And she married Roger Wolfe Kahn and Dorothy, my wife, took her place in the show. For a while. But then the show went on the road and Dorothy didn't go. They got somebody else. She stayed in New York with the baby.
